Bug_Title: SING: Class using singleton design pattern directly or indirectly implements Serializable interface. (SING_SINGLETON_IMPLEMENTS_SERIALIZABLE)
Bug_Details:
This class (using singleton design pattern) directly or indirectly implements the Serializable interface, which allows the class to be serialized.
Deserialization makes multiple instantiation of a singleton class possible, and therefore should be avoided.
SEI CERT MSC07-J rule
Bug_Explanation: The SingletonExample class implements the Serializable interface, allowing it to be serialized and deserialized. This can lead to multiple instances of the singleton class being created, violating the singleton pattern.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method of SingletonExample, which serializes and then deserializes the singleton instance. If the deserialized instance is different from the original, it indicates the bug.
